actual: The runtime catalog omits backend/services/dataset_release/factor_materializer.py from the dataset worker target. A valid dataset-release change set is therefore inferred as backend-main plus worker-scheduler and finish fails closed with two restart targets even though factor_materializer is executed by the dataset build child process, not FastAPI. Classify the file under the correct worker target, preserve genuine multi-target fail-closed behavior, and add an exact regression for the BUG-1471 changed-file set.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: The runtime catalog omits backend/services/dataset_release/factor_materializer.py from the dataset worker target. A valid dataset-release change set is therefore inferred as backend-main plus worker-scheduler and finish fails closed with two restart targets even though factor_materializer is executed by the dataset build child process, not FastAPI. Classify the file under the correct worker target, preserve genuine multi-target fail-closed behavior, and add an exact regression for the BUG-1471 changed-file set.
expected: The BUG-1471 dataset-release source/build change set resolves to worker-scheduler only, factor_materializer.py never falls through to backend-main, and a genuine backend plus worker change remains multi-target and fail-closed.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
